import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. # `{title}` and `{body}` are placeholders that will be replaced by the sanitized # heading and description respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on the webpage. Notes ----- * The function escapes all characters that have special meaning in HTML (e.g., <, >, &, ", ') to prevent cross‑site scripting attacks. * The returned string is safe for direct inclusion in an HTML page because no raw user input is rendered without escaping. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Replace placeholders in the template with the escaped values formatted_blog = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_blog
